args.summary: The v2.3.1 deploy of checkout-api failed health checks across all production regions, with error rates reaching 18%. Rolled back all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. The first rollback attempt hit an orchestrator error after completing only us-east, so the rollback was retried and fully succeeded. Service is now healthy on v2.3.0 in all regions with error rate at 0.2%.

trace.final:
All done. Summary of what happened:

1. **Diagnosis**: The latest deploy of checkout-api, v2.3.1, was unhealthy in production. The most recent healthy production release was v2.3.0.

2. **Rollback**: Rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0. The first attempt failed partway (orchestrator error after us-east), leaving us-west and eu-west on the broken v2.3.1 with an 18% error rate. A retry completed successfully, putting us-east, us-west, and eu-west all on v2.3.0.

3. **Verification**: checkout-api is now healthy across all three regions, with error rate down to 0.2%.

4. **Incident**: Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api rolled back to v2.3.0 after unhealthy v2.3.1 deploy") describing the rollback, the partial-failure retry, and current healthy state. On-call has been paged. (The first incident-creation request timed out, but the retry with the same idempotency key confirmed no duplicate was created.)
